overall: The AG found the Westport Planning Board violated the Open Meeting Law by omitting a list of documents and exhibits used at its June 18, 2024 meeting from the minutes, and ordered amended minutes and future compliance.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the June 18, 2024 minutes were inaccurate because they did not list documents or other exhibits used during the meeting.
allegations.key_passage: For the reasons stated above, we find that the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by creating insufficient minutes of the meeting held on June 18, 2024.

remedy: Amend the minutes of the June 18, 2024 meeting to list the documents and exhibits used, within 30 days of the letter.
Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law's requirements; similar future violations could be considered evidence of intent to violate the law.
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
